hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Intentional muted coral/teal palette and clean UI hierarchy show design thinking, but the visualization is cropped at the bottom of the viewport and the dual accent colors (blue active state + green button) create an unresolved tension in the controls.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for force-layout circle radii and sunburst radial scaling, data-driven domains via d3.extent, key functions present for object constancy, and no baseline violations or dual-axis deception in this topology-first layout.
flags: Update Storm (tension-slider fires redrawLinks() on every input — 300 path mutations/tick, no RAF or debounce)
Update Storm (easing-param sliders call updateLayout() on every input, restarting a 1500ms transition storm during drag)
Mouse-Touch Fight (force-layout drag registers no .filter() guard against touch-scroll conflicts on mobile)
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Two un-throttled input→render paths create jank under rapid slider interaction, and the force drag lacks touch/scroll filtering; transition interrupt handling is otherwise solid via D3 implicit interruption.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Two-hue palette and single-view layout keep cognitive load low, but the edge bundle crossing zone between clusters collapses into a dark tangle that makes individual connections unreadable without hover; 8 layout-switch buttons add minor control complexity that animation-heavy transitions (unassessable from screenshot) could amplify.
